commits.subject: fix(auth): close final publication and recovery races

R3-CAND-018-F1: Ordinary loads require providers or credential_pool and preserve invalid primary bytes as read-only corruption with SHA-256 evidence.
Persisted top-level fields, including suppressed_sources, are schema-validated; explicitly scoped legacy empty/suppression readers normalize only their documented compatibility forms.
R3-CAND-018-F2: Recovery carries the reviewed corrupt-source digest through the locked save path and rechecks it immediately before publication and inside the publication primitive.
Stale ordinary snapshots fail with explicit AuthStoreWriteConflictError and cannot erase a recovered store.
R3-CAND-018-F3: Windows publication uses a native SetFileInformationByHandle rename from a DELETE-capable validated source handle, retains and revalidates the no-reparse parent identity, and rejects source/parent identity mismatch before publication.
R3-CAND-018-F4: Windows sidecars use exclusive temporary creation and no-replace hard-link publication while a retained parent handle denies delete sharing; collisions and reparse destinations fail closed without overwriting incumbent evidence or leaking redirected copies.
Sidecar publication verifies final link identity and bytes before reporting preservation success.
